title: HHT-alpha one-step and multi-step three-state amplification
source: Hilber, Hughes and Taylor (1977), Improved numerical dissipation for time integration algorithms in structural dynamics, Earthquake Engineering & Structural Dynamics 5, 283–292; the three-state amplification recursion follows the published equilibrium and Newmark kinematics.

quantities.quantity: HHT one-step displacement column 1
quantities.reason: The value is the corresponding entry of the closed-form one-step HHT amplification matrix obtained from the stated alpha, beta=(1-alpha)^2/4, gamma=0.5-alpha and dt. The full state is (u,v,a), so its amplification matrix is 3x3.
